_meta.title: CA Land-Secured CFD — Master Developer Corporate Credit Sheet
_meta.build_method: Mapped CFD names + project_type + known California master-planned community lineage to public homebuilder / private developer entities. Pulled credit ratings from rating-agency press releases, SEC 10-Q/10-K filings, and issuer IR pages. NO PAYWALLED DATA. Private developers with no public credit data marked UNVERIFIABLE.
honesty_notes: Most 117 CFDs do NOT have an explicit top_taxpayer_name in the per-obligor JSONs (the prior build was issuer-level, not parcel-level). Master-developer mapping below is best-effort from public knowledge of CA master-planned communities and the small set of CFDs where the developer name was documented (Diablo Grande, Northstar, Irvine Great Park, Palmdale Ritter Ranch).

Mature / built-out master plans (Stevenson Ranch, Rancho Santa Margarita, Ladera Ranch, Mountain Park, Talega, Stanford Ranch, Whitney Ranch, Lincoln Crossing, Black Mountain Ranch, Santaluz) typically no longer have a single concentrated master developer at the snapshot date — taxpayer base is fragmented to individual homeowners. Marked CONCENTRATION_LOW for those.
For most generic city-numbered CFDs (e.g., Fontana CFD 11, Indio CFD 2004-3) the developer composition is heterogeneous and not publicly identified. Marked DEVELOPER_UNKNOWN.
